title: The Yakyuuken Special: Kon'ya wa 12-kaisen!!
native_title: ザ・野球拳・スペシャル ～今夜は１２回戦！！～
overview:
A first in history! A special version of "Yakyuuken" featuring 12 beautiful women.

If you're confident in your skills, come and take us on!!

The Yakyuuken Special: Kon'ya wa 12-kaisen!! is an adult strip rock-paper-scissors game featuring photographed models. Choose one of 12 women as your opponent and pick rock, paper or scissors each round. Every win makes her lose a piece of clothing, but lose five times and the game is over and you start again.

- 12 opponents
- For adults 18 and over
- One player

史上初！12人の美女が収められた「野球拳」スペシャルバージョン

ウデに自信のある人、私たちにかかってきて！！
